exposure: End-stage kidney disease (ESKD) modality (hemodialysis [HD], peritoneal dialysis, transplantation)
cohort: Women aged 18 to 44 years with ESKD registered in the US Renal Data System from 2002 to 2015
finding: The study found that the delivery rate in women with ESKD increased from 2002 to 2015 among those treated with transplantation or HD, with women who had a kidney transplant being less likely to deliver preterm but more likely to have a cesarean delivery compared to those undergoing HD.
mod_finding: Women with a kidney transplant were more likely to have a cesarean delivery compared to women undergoing HD.
